name: HanaAgent Workbench
description: Hanaco intelligent agent workbench inspired by Hermes Workspace: agent/session probe, mission dispatch, task board, and workflow templates.

defaultAgentId.title: Default Agent ID
defaultAgentId.description: Optional agent id to preselect in HanaAgent Workbench.

defaultSessionPath.title: Default Session Path
defaultSessionPath.description: Optional existing session path used as the default dispatch target.

workspaceRoots.title: Workspace Roots
workspaceRoots.description: Optional directories exposed to HanaAgent Files. Entries may be strings or objects with path, label, and writable.

knowledgeSource.title: Knowledge Source
knowledgeSource.description: Hermes knowledge API compatibility source label. HanaAgent maps knowledge pages to OpenHanako memory and local plugin memory.

autopilotSchedule.title: Autopilot Schedule
autopilotSchedule.description: Background autopilot tick settings. Example: { enabled, mode, intervalMinutes, runOnStartup, maxMissionsPerTick }.

workerLifecyclePolicy.title: Worker Lifecycle Policy
workerLifecyclePolicy.description: Swarm2-style worker context lifecycle thresholds for watch, handoff, renewal, and stale checkpoints.

savedMissions.title: Saved Mission Drafts
savedMissions.description: Local mission drafts shown in the workbench.

pinnedSessions.title: Pinned Sessions
pinnedSessions.description: Frequently used sessions shown as quick targets in HanaAgent Workbench.

pinnedModels.title: Pinned Models
pinnedModels.description: Preferred models shown as quick selections in HanaAgent Workbench.

modelMetadata.title: Model Metadata
modelMetadata.description: Optional model context and price metadata for HanaAgent recommendations. Entries may include model, provider, contextWindow, inputCostPer1M, outputCostPer1M.

savedBoardViews.title: Saved Board Views
savedBoardViews.description: Saved HanaAgent TaskBoard filters for quick board view switching.

boardWipLimits.title: Board WIP Limits
boardWipLimits.description: Optional per-lane Kanban WIP limits. Use 0 or omit a lane for unlimited.

sessionAliases.title: Session Aliases
sessionAliases.description: Workbench-local session title aliases used for Hermes-style rename display.

sessionTombstones.title: Session Tombstones
sessionTombstones.description: Workbench-local hidden session markers used for Hermes-style delete cleanup without deleting host files.

workbenchModes.title: Workbench Modes
workbenchModes.description: Hermes-style saved workbench mode presets with model, session, board, and suggestion preferences.

activeWorkbenchModeId.title: Active Workbench Mode ID
activeWorkbenchModeId.description: Currently applied HanaAgent workbench mode preset id for drift detection.

workbenchNotifications.title: Workbench Notifications
workbenchNotifications.description: Hermes-style local notification settings for HanaAgent sounds, browser notifications, and mobile haptics.

workbenchSettings.title: Workbench Settings
workbenchSettings.description: Hermes-style local workbench settings: theme, accent, editor preferences, context threshold, metrics footer, and mobile navigation mode.

workbenchOnboarding.title: Workbench Onboarding
workbenchOnboarding.description: Hermes-style onboarding tour state for HanaAgent Workbench.

hermesGatewayUrl.title: Hermes Gateway URL
hermesGatewayUrl.description: Hermes compatibility connection override. OpenHanako-safe default uses the host runtime.

hermesDashboardUrl.title: Hermes Dashboard URL
hermesDashboardUrl.description: Hermes compatibility dashboard override. OpenHanako-safe default points at the HanaAgent workbench.
